title: RDFa vs Microdata vs JSON-LD: The Evolution of Structured Data for SEO
description: Explore how structured data has evolved from RDFa to Microdata to JSON-LD. Learn the advantages of each, why JSON-LD is now Google’s preferred format, and how companies should update their websites and blogs.

title: JSON-LD Explained: Advantages, Best Practices, and When Not to Use
description: Learn what JSON-LD is, its advantages for SEO, when to use it, and when not to. Discover best practices, pitfalls to avoid, and how it compares to microdata and RDFa.
